## Summary

Describe the outcome and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `corepack pnpm run ci` passes locally, or failures are explained
- [ ] Tests were added/updated, or the reason they are unnecessary is documented
- [ ] Documentation and API contracts were updated when relevant

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No secret, credential, personal data, identity document, or real location data is included
- [ ] Authorization/IDOR, input validation, logging, and rate-limit impact were reviewed
- [ ] Dependency additions and lifecycle scripts were reviewed
- [ ] Migration and rollback impact is documented, or not applicable

## Scope

- [ ] The pull request contains one logical change
- [ ] Out-of-scope follow-up work is linked as an issue
